verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents a configurable review workflow in which cases are submitted for approval and approvers can be added under peer-approval settings. It also files reports directly to FinCEN. The evidence does not explicitly show that the approval step gates external submission, or that only authorized roles can approve. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that filing to FinCEN is blocked until approval, role-based approver authorization controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can require an authorized human approval before an externally submitted regulatory report

citations.quote: You must be the assignee of the case in order to add an approver, and the workflow must be configured to allow for peer approvals.
We can easily configure your Hummingbird account with workflows that mirror your policies.
you can track your filing as we batch it, deliver it to FINCEN, and when FINCEN processes it
